output.explanation: NIG-AE invoiced AED 57,000.00 (NIG-AE:ICV-AE-031305, AE-ICINV-00483) for the secondment of Daniel Wang on P-24017. NIG-SA booked AED 54,150.00 (NIG-SA:ICV-SA-018978), with the description 'net of WHT 5%'. The buyer-to-seller ratio of 0.95 matches the Saudi 5% withholding rate on services, leaving an AED 2,850.00 gap (USD 776.03 at the invoice-date rate).
output.recommended_action: NIG-SA should reclassify the AED 2,850.00 withheld from the IC payable to the WHT payable/remitted account, and provide the WHT certificate to NIG-AE so it can recognise the tax credit or receivable and clear the IC balance.
output.adjustment_description: Gross up the NIG-SA IC payable to NIG-AE by AED 2,850.00 against WHT payable to ZATCA. On settlement, NIG-AE clears the AED 2,850.00 residual receivable against the WHT tax credit or receivable, supported by the certificate.
